summary: Research completed: VecEADecomp cannot directly fill the sorry at NfCharFormula.lean:540 because VecEADecomp handles depth-0 3-var existentials only, while the sorry is at depth k+1 (arbitrary k). The k=0 case is already sorry-free. The depth k+1 case requires a composition theorem for non-interval zones: knowing x's depth-(k+1) 1-var NF + t's predicates + Prior-UZ/SZ must determine the full 3-var quantifier profile. Three approaches identified: (A) arity-generalized induction P2_gen(k,n), (B) formula construction encoding all zone conditions, (C) classical existence proof. The NegationClosure.lean master_induction is the best existing attempt but hits the same wall at nf_exist_formula_nested_backward. Import feasibility confirmed: no circular dependencies prevent importing VecEADecomp into either NfCharFormula or NegationClosure.

blockers.description: Composition theorem for non-interval 3-var zones at depth k+1
blockers.mathematical_content: Given depth-(k+1) 1-var NF of x, predicates of t, and Prior-UZ/SZ, determine whether exists y with specific depth-k 3-var NF at (y,x,t) for y outside the interval [t,x]
options: A: Generalize P2 to arbitrary arity (P2_gen(k,n) for all n) -- matches Rabinovich Section 5
B: Encode ALL zone conditions in the formula (not just interval) -- may hit formalizability issues
C: Classical existence proof using finite model property on Prior structures
